title: Because Of, As a Result Of: Causes in Education

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *debido a* "because of" and *a raíz de* "as a result of" from B1 Unit 6. Both take a noun (*debido a la migración*), never a verb; with a verb, use *porque*. They suit the story of languages: what made speakers fewer, and what changed after a law.

items.spanish: Debido a la migración a las ciudades, muchos niños ya no aprenden la lengua de sus abuelos.
items.english: Because of migration to the cities, many children no longer learn their grandparents' language.

items.spanish: A raíz de la Constitución de 1992, el guaraní es lengua oficial de Paraguay junto al castellano.
items.english: As a result of the 1992 Constitution, Guaraní is an official language of Paraguay together with Spanish.

items.spanish: Muchas familias dejaron de hablar la lengua porque la escuela enseñaba solo en castellano.
items.english: Many families stopped speaking the language because school taught only in Spanish.

items.spanish: Debido a las aplicaciones y a los cursos, hay más personas que estudian quechua.
items.english: Because of apps and courses, more people study Quechua.

sections.content: *Debido a* and *a raíz de* are followed by a noun phrase. Do not write *debido a se mudan* or *a raíz a la ley*: the second part of *a raíz de* is always *de*.
